source_facts: SETTINGS declares combatStyle options [melee, mage, range], rangeStyle (default rapid), ammo (default 'Bronze arrow'), ammoWithdraw (min 1, max 5000) and banking options [None, Auto].
RANGE_MODE = parseRangeStyle(this.settings.str('rangeStyle', 'rapid')); the fight loop compares Game.combatMode() === RANGE_MODE and calls Game.setCombatMode(RANGE_MODE).
wieldedAmmo() counts AMMO in worn equipment, so the projectile has to leave the ammo slot for a discharge to exist.
restockThreshold() = ammoWithdraw x ammoRestockBelow(default 25)% = 200 x 25% = 50, so the worn 200 stack never trips an ammo bank trip; banking=None is the branch this cell proves.

source_facts: POTIONS = plannedPotions(carry) with no loadout entry resolving to one Super attack(3) and one Super strength(3) (api/combat/boostPotions.ts).
The fight loop calls sipUpkeep, which drinks the planned dose form found in the pack and requires Skills.effective(skill) to rise within 3 ticks.
potionToSip requests a dose only while boostFaded(base, effective) holds (boost between 0 and 10% of base), so an unboosted pre-Start state is what makes the first sip a real transition.
Dose forms are the card's own ids 145/147 (Super attack) and 157/159 (Super strength).
